payment.subtitle: With pay-first, guests pay by card before the ticket ever reaches your kitchen. No walkouts, no unpaid tabs, no chasing — every order is settled the instant it is placed.

steps.order: Guest scans and builds their order
steps.pay: Pays securely by card via Stripe
steps.kitchen: Order hits the kitchen — money hits your account

commission.title: 0% commission to you
commission.text: You keep the full order amount, minus only standard Stripe card fees. The small service fee is added to the guest total — never taken from yours.

direct.title: Money lands in your account
direct.text: Payments settle directly to your own Stripe account and your bank. ODS never holds your funds.

noShows.title: Zero no-shows & walkouts
noShows.text: The order only reaches the kitchen once payment succeeds, so every prepared ticket is already paid.

fee.title: A tiny, fair service fee
fee.text: A small fee scales with the basket — from €0.20 on small tickets up to €1.00 on large ones — shown to the guest before they pay.

refunds.title: Refunds built in
refunds.text: Refund a single item or a whole order in a click, with automatic month-end settlement of platform fees back to you.

global.title: Works worldwide
global.text: Charge in every Stripe-supported country and currency, with the fee shown in the guest local currency.

mock.secured: Secured by Stripe · cards never touch ODS

connect.title: LAN, USB & Windows printers

routing.title: Routed by station
